items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 10 at 5:13AM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Total snow accumulations 4 to 12 inches.

* WHERE...Broad Pass.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...An early season snowfall is expected for Broad
Pass through Sunday morning. Steady snow this morning may mix with
rain and taper off for a time this afternoon before changing back
to all snow Saturday evening through Sunday morning. Snow totals
will be highly dependent on temperatures with daytime highs in the
lower to mi
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 10 at 4:51AM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations up to 8 inches along
portions of the Parks Highway. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph may
result in areas of blowing snow.

* WHERE...Southern Denali Borough, especially south of Denali Park.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...An early season snowfall is expected tonight through
Saturday night. Rain may mix in on Saturday, but roads and
especially bridges are likely to become slick and snow covered.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 10 at 4:51AM AKDT until October 11 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Snow begins Saturday morning then becomes
heavier Saturday night with total snow accumulations up to 8 inches
by Sunday evening. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph may result in
areas of blowing snow.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 4 PM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...An early season snowfall is expected late tonight through
Sunday. Roads and especially bridges are likely to become slick and
snow covered.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 10 at 4:46AM AKDT until October 11 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 70 mph.

* WHERE...Northern Denali Borough.

* WHEN...Until 1 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds could blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Use extra caution when driving, especially if operating a high
profile vehicle. Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 10 at 4:46AM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 75 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds may blow down trees and power lines.
Travel will be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
People should avoid being outside in forested areas. Use caution if
you must drive.
